entries.title: Crewmate summaries stay readable in narrow windows
entries.body: Summaries use clear space beside your sidebars. If none remains, they appear above the sidebars. The fleet remains visible through the sidebars. Crewmate labels stay with their crewmates in right-to-left languages.

picture.alt: A crewmate's summary sits in the open space beside the sidebar with its text unobscured
